A. D. Beadell Investment Counsel Inc. lessened its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 5.6% during the 3rd quarter, Holdings Channel reports. The firm owned 9,991 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 595 shares during the period. A. D. Beadell Investment Counsel Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $1,539,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.

Apple Inc. has a fifty-two week low of $118.21 and a fifty-two week high of $177.20. The company has a current ratio of 1.28, a quick ratio of 1.23 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Thursday, November 2nd. The iPhone maker reported $2.07 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $1.87 by $0.20. The business had revenue of $52.58 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $50.71 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.09% and a return on equity of 36.29%. The firm’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.2% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the previous year, the company earned $1.50 earnings per share. analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.18 EPS for the current year.
